rubricScores.criterion: Found the MSB3073 error in the DataSources project's signing step and identified the specific file(s) that failed
Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in shared folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects set Distrib to same path
Identified CAS read-only hard links making files unsignable
Explained non-determinism based on which project's signing runs first / timing
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so only service project owns the folder
Verified the fix ensures each project signs only its own files

scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
scenarios.reasoning: A thorough, well-evidenced investigation that hits nearly all rubric points with cross-referenced binlog data. The root cause (shared Distrib folder + wildcard glob signing foreign artifacts) is correct and well substantiated. Weakness: the read-only/CAS hard-link mechanism is somewhat hedged and partly speculative, and the recommended fixes, while sound, are not as decisive as removing Distrib from library projects.
